---
name: "Warden Hut"
level: 3
school: evocation
casting_time: 1 minute
range: Self (10-foot-radius hemisphere)
components:
- V
- S
- M
duration: 8 hours
classes:
- bard
- wizard
ritual: true
material: a small crystal bead
---

A 10-foot-radius immobile dome of force springs into existence around and above you and remains stationary for the duration. The spell ends if you leave its area. Nine creatures of Medium size or smaller can fit inside. The dome is opaque from the outside, any color you choose, but transparent from the inside. The atmosphere inside is comfortable and dry, regardless of the weather outside.
